title: Eosinophil–cotinine coupling does not establish incremental cross-cycle FEV1 prediction
abstract: A prespecified eosinophil-by-log-cotinine product did not establish incremental FEV1 prediction across separately sampled NHANES 2007–08→2011–12 collections (n=3718→3627): target MSE reduction -15.07 mL², joint PSU-bootstrap95% interval [-1178.97, 851.53]. This is an exploratory external-cycle negative result, not independent-cohort confirmation or proof of no biological interaction.
